caption: The drawing shows an ornate wooden chair back and seat with elaborate carvings. The upper part features a large, carved panel with reddish-brown and golden wood tones, bordered by intricate scrollwork. At the very top center, there is a detailed carving of a bird with open wings, colored in tones of red, brown, and gold. Just below the bird, a curved section includes swirling leaf patterns in a yellowish-gold hue. The rectangular backrest of the chair is accented with vertical segments and more carved details, including floral motifs and small faces or masks. The bottom section illustrates the chair’s seat front with further carvings, including several lion or human faces evenly spaced across the central horizontal band, surrounded by acanthus leaves and scrolls. The entire composition exhibits a consistent color palette of warm brown, gold, and yellow tones, with shading and highlights emphasizing the three-dimensional texture of the carving. The background is plain and off-white, with a faint rectangular border suggesting the edge of the drawing.
title: Bedstead
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
